'''Julio Rodríguez Martínez''' (25 April 1928 – 28 January 1979) was a Spanish politician who served as [[Ministry of Education (Spain)|Minister of Education and Science of Spain]] between 1973 and 1974, during the [[Francoist dictatorship]].<ref>{{cite web |author=''[[Diccionario biográfico español]]'' |url=https://historia-hispanica.rah.es/biografias/39493-julio-rodriguez-martinez |title=Personajes: Julio Rodríguez Martínez |year=2022 |language=es |website=Historia Hispánica |publisher=[[Royal Academy of History]] |access-date=31 August 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Medialdea |first=Sara |date=28 June 2015 |url=https://www.abc.es/espana/20150628/abci-julito-breve-educacion-201506261937.html |title=El ministro de Educación más breve de la historia |language=es |newspaper=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]] |access-date=14 October 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Rodríguez |first=Ignacio José |date=17 August 2024 |url=https://www.laregion.es/opinion/julio-rodriguez-martinez-ministro-muy-gallego_1_20240817-3335597.html |title=Julio Rodríguez Martínez, un ministro muy gallego |language=es |newspaper=[[La Región]] |access-date=31 August 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|publisher=Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado|journal=Boletín Oficial del Estado|issue=140|date=12 June 1973|language=es|title=Decreto 1159/1973, de 11 de junio, por el que se nombran los Ministros del Gobierno|url=https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/1973/06/12/pdfs/A11883-11883.pdf|issn=0212-033X|page=11883}}</ref>
